scripts.build: node -e "const c=require('child_process'); const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); c.execSync('npm --prefix .. ci',{stdio:'inherit'}); c.execSync('npm --prefix .. run build',{stdio:'inherit'}); const src=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'..','build'); const dst=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'build'); fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true}); console.log('Shim build complete:', dst);"
